entries.what: Isabel wakes at 6:50 after a midnight session on Ramón's old desktop, gets a ride from Grace at 7:30 and eats little at school.
entries.outcome: Arrived on time, with the car ride mostly silent.

entries.what: Between classes she finally emails draft 7 of her marsh personal statement to Ms. Lugo, after drafting an apology that it is still rough.
entries.outcome: Draft sent; Ms. Lugo reads one draft a week, so feedback comes Friday.

entries.what: After school she does homework at the library homework center, then walks home and does the dishes.
entries.outcome: Finished AP Calc problems and cleared the dishes.

entries.what: Tuesday robotics in room C7 from 3:30 to 6, working on the drivetrain with Lucas nearby.
entries.outcome: Mechanical subteam finished a gearbox mount.

entries.what: Ramón is on a 24-hour dispatch shift, so Isabel makes sure Lola Cora takes her lunch and eats dinner with Grace and Lola Cora.
entries.outcome: Dinner passed with only a small argument over bedtime.

entries.what: Late evening she studies for the AP Chem unit and sets her alarm for 6:50.
entries.outcome: Asleep around 1 a.m.

entries.what: Wednesday classes; at lunch she tells Nadia she needs to make up a missed APUSH reading response from the robotics all-nighter.
entries.outcome: Nadia says to just email the teacher.

entries.what: She emails her APUSH teacher about a makeup reading response and has the assistant check her tone; it was a one-off after a robotics build night, and she still wants her grade protected.
entries.outcome: Sent a polite email.

entries.what: Mateo math at 4 p.m.: she tutors Mateo in ratios for $20.
entries.outcome: Mateo got three problems right in a row.

entries.what: Thursday classes and robotics in C7 from 3:30 to 6 testing the drivetrain; Lucas mentions he expects his SAT score soon.
entries.outcome: Test run went fine and Isabel noticed Lucas's confidence.

entries.what: Grace comes home talking about the St. Anselm nurses union vote, which is on the news; Isabel half-listens while writing a college list update.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening.

entries.what: She does late-night college list work on the old desktop.
entries.outcome: Slept around 1 a.m.

entries.what: Her SAT score is released: 1450, with 720 reading and 730 math. She checks it in the library before the game and tells Nadia.
entries.outcome: Score is up from her 1340 PSAT-equivalent.

entries.what: Ms. Lugo returns feedback on draft 7 in the hallway, a few comments with encouragement.
entries.outcome: Next revision is manageable.

entries.what: Before the homecoming game she asks the assistant for a casual way to mention the score at dinner without looking like she cares what Grace thinks.
entries.outcome: Chose a throwaway line to drop over dinner.

entries.what: She goes to the Egrets homecoming game with Nadia for yearbook photos, skipping the dance.
entries.outcome: Took photos and was home on time.

entries.what: Saturday morning she skips the library SAT prep and sleeps in, since the test is behind her; Lucas mentions his own score in the group chat.
entries.outcome: Lucas's score is a bit higher than hers.

entries.what: She asks the assistant for the percentile of a 1450 compared with people applying to engineering.
entries.outcome: Got numbers and felt steadier.

entries.what: Afternoon she photographs marsh birds at Ulloa Salt Marsh Park and logs her tally.
entries.outcome: Logged a dozen egrets.

entries.what: Home by 9 p.m. under her curfew, she watches Lola Cora's teleserye at full volume.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening.

entries.what: Sunday morning Lola Cora goes to Tagalog Mass while Grace grades, and Isabel helps with sinigang prep.
entries.outcome: Sinigang for lunch.

entries.what: Afternoon she does homework in her room and picks one revision to fix in the essay based on Ms. Lugo's notes.
entries.outcome: Revised one paragraph.

entries.what: Evening she does dishes and tells Ramón her score.
entries.outcome: Ramón is proud and quietly hopeful.
